description: The Foundry star chart — planet and zone positions for the interactive map. x/y in a 1200x800 SVG space.

planets.description: Closest to the sun. Captain Vor's territory — farm him for early Rhino parts.
planets.name: Mercury

planets.description: Corpus territory. The Jackal and Sergeant Nef Anyo hold Rhino and Mag parts.
planets.name: Venus

planets.description: Home. Vay Hek drops Hydroid parts; Cetus gates the Plains of Eidolon.
planets.name: Earth

planets.description: Grineer foundries. Lech Kril drops Excalibur parts.
planets.name: Mars

planets.description: Mars' moon. Corpus outpost with rare containers.
planets.name: Phobos

planets.description: Dark Sector hotspot. Gabii is the classic Orokin Cell and resource farm.
planets.name: Ceres

planets.description: Gas giant. Alad V drops Mesa and Valkyr parts; the Ropalolyst lurks here.
planets.name: Jupiter

planets.description: Icy moon. The Raptors drop Nova parts.
planets.name: Europa

planets.description: Ringed giant. Sargas Ruk drops Ember parts; Helene is a top Orokin Cell farm.
planets.name: Saturn

planets.description: Storm world. Tyl Regor drops Equinox parts; Ophelia survival farms Manics.
planets.name: Uranus

planets.description: Deep blue. The Hyena Pack drops Loki parts.
planets.name: Neptune

planets.description: Dwarf planet. Ambulas drops Trinity parts.
planets.name: Pluto

planets.description: Infested space. Mutalist Alad V drops Mesa parts; the Jordas Golem flies here.
planets.name: Eris

planets.description: Edge of the system. Kela De Thaym drops Saryn parts.
planets.name: Sedna

zones.description: Cetus' hunting grounds. Eidolon hunts at night for arcanes and shards; fish, mine, and gather for amps and zaws.
zones.name: Plains of Eidolon

zones.description: Fortuna's frozen frontier. Toroids, Exploiter Orb, Profit-Taker — and some of the best mining in the game.
zones.name: Orb Vallis

zones.description: The Infested open world. Fish, mine, and hunt Necramechs; Orokin Vaults hide Corrupted mods.
zones.name: Cambion Drift

zones.description: The Infested moon. Lephantis drops Nekros parts; the Necralisk is your hub.
zones.name: Deimos

zones.description: Earth's shattered moon. Lua's Halls farm for Drift mods and Lua Thrax Plasm.
zones.name: Lua

zones.description: Where Prime parts live. Argon Crystals, relic cracking in Fissures, Corrupted Vor.
zones.name: The Void

zones.description: Grineer fortress. Kuva Siphons and Floods for Kuva; Kuva Liches are born here.
zones.name: Kuva Fortress

zones.description: The Zariman Ten Zero. Thrax drop Molt arcanes; Void Cascade is the endgame farm.
zones.name: Zariman Ten Zero

zones.description: Albrecht's Laboratories. The Murmur and new lab resources live here.
zones.name: Sanctum Anatomica

zones.description: 1999. Fight the Scaldra and Techrot for Höllvanian resources.
zones.name: Höllvania (1999)

zones.description: The spiral. Pathos Clamps, Kullervo, and the Orowyrm.
zones.name: Duviri

zones.description: Ship-to-ship combat across the Proximas. Titanium, Asterite, and crew for your Railjack.
zones.name: Railjack Proximas
